doc: Every call of a transcendental Math function (sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh asinh acosh atanh exp expm1 log log1p log2 log10 pow hypot cbrt fround) made while the context ran, deduplicated by (function, argument bits) in first-call order, with V8 results. "round" entries are Math.round calls on an exact half (x - floor(x) === 0.5), where JS rounds toward +Infinity and Luau math.round rounds away from zero. Contexts: dungeon:<seed> = generateDungeon + placeEncounter + entranceSpawn + bossDoorSpawn; run:<file> = createSimState + every step() of that run (NOT the scripted bot).
